name: Joah
overview: The figure of Joah in Scripture is primarily identified as the son of Asaph, serving as a recorder or scribe during King Hezekiah's reign, as seen in Isaiah 36. Joah's role alongside Eliakim and Shebna highlights his involvement in critical communications during a time of crisis, notably in interactions with the Assyrian envoy Rabshakeh. Additionally, other mentions of Joah as a Levite, a descendant of Gershom, and a son of Obed-edom suggest that this name refers to multiple individuals dedicated to temple service and repair, underscoring a legacy of faithful ministry within the Levitical line.
